title: Mercury 2.5 LLM hits 770 tokens per second

paragraphs.en: Mercury 2.5 is below average in intelligence, but reasonably priced when comparing to other models of similar price. It's also notably fast and highly concise. The model supports text input, outputs text, and has a 260k tokens context window.
paragraphs.zh: Mercury 2.5 的智能水平低于平均，但与其他价格相近的模型相比，它的定价较为合理。 它的速度也明显很快，且回答高度简洁。 该模型支持文本输入、输出文本，并拥有 260k token 的上下文窗口。

sents.zh: 它的速度也明显很快，且回答高度简洁。

sents.zh: 该模型支持文本输入、输出文本，并拥有 260k token 的上下文窗口。

paragraphs.en: Mercury 2.5 scores 12 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, placing it below average among comparable models (median: 13). When evaluating the Intelligence Index, it generated 35M tokens, which is very concise in comparison to the median of 100M.
paragraphs.zh: Mercury 2.5 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数中得分为 12，在同类模型中低于平均水平（中位数：13）。 在评估智能指数时，它生成了 3500 万个 token，与 1 亿的中位数相比非常简洁。

paragraphs.en: Pricing for Mercury 2.5 is $0.25 per 1M input tokens (somewhat expensive, median: $0.24) and $0.75 per 1M output tokens (moderately priced, median: $0.80). On average, it costs $0.12 per task to evaluate Mercury 2.5 on the Intelligence Index.
paragraphs.zh: Mercury 2.5 的定价为每 100 万输入 tokens 0.25 美元（偏贵，中位数：0.24 美元），每 100 万输出 tokens 0.75 美元（价格适中，中位数：0.80 美元）。 平均而言，在 Intelligence Index 上评估 Mercury 2.5 每个任务的成本为 0.12 美元。

paragraphs.en: AA-Briefcase Elo is a combined metric that aggregates analytical quality Elo, presentation Elo, and rubric pass rate, with rubric performance converted into Elo via synthetic head-to-head matches. Elo and 95% confidence interval bounds are clamped at 0.
paragraphs.zh: AA-Briefcase Elo 是一个综合指标，它聚合了分析质量 Elo、演示效果 Elo 和评分细则通过率，其中评分细则表现通过合成的两两对比赛制转换为 Elo。 Elo 及 95% 置信区间边界值均下限截断为 0。

paragraphs.en: AA-Omniscience Index (higher is better) measures knowledge reliability and hallucination. It rewards correct answers, penalizes hallucinations, and has no penalty for refusing to answer. Scores range from -100 to 100, where 0 means as many correct as incorrect answers, and negative scores mean more incorrect than correct.
paragraphs.zh: AA-Omniscience 指数（越高越好）用于衡量知识可靠性与幻觉情况。 它奖励正确答案，惩罚幻觉，并且对拒答不设惩罚。 分数范围为 -100 到 100，其中 0 表示正确答案与错误答案数量相同，负分表示错误答案多于正确答案。
